name: brute
note: The back view's lean never crosses zero (-0.014 .. -0.077 across all 21 walk frames): from behind, the legs are inside the silhouette and there is no alternation for gaitSignals to see. The walk row is therefore picked as a sway out and back rather than a left/right cycle. Attack is ordered coil -> wind -> STRIKE -> recover, not by frame number: the strike (00565, bbox 517 wide against 411 coiled) happens early in the clip and the settle follows it. Stumble is the cleanest of the three: the body really does absorb, 582 -> 544 -> 488 tall over three frames.
